question: Cat-sensei, please tell us about some of your favorite Re episodes that even you find yourself rereading over and over! Also, since the serialization has gone on for so long, we'd love to know roughly how many times you've reread the story so far!
answer:
I often reread things while also looking at the reactions, thinking, “I wonder what everyone thought about this.” So I tend to reread episodes that received a lot of reactions.

If we're talking about how well a volume comes together as a whole, there's Volume 31, The Sword Demon Island of Ginnunhive, where Subaru spends an entire volume having a pretty miserable time. I like that volume because it comes together nicely as a single book while also having some really exciting developments, so I reread it often.

Of course, I also frequently reread the volumes containing episodes I particularly like, such as Volume 6's “From Zero” and Volume 15's “Choose Me.” And I reread them to remind myself of setting details that I mustn't forget, too. Reinhard in particular is often a case of, “Wait, how much of this have I written already?” If I end up not writing something that I was supposed to write, that wouldn't be good, so I look back over things to make sure.

While I'm in the middle of writing a story, I also reread episodes related to the characters who are going to appear. For example, Arc 10 is about Crusch-san, Ferris, and the others appearing again after a long absence, so I reread Arc 5 and EX1.
